The failing test is `testGetOptions_Order()` in the class `org.apache.commons.cli2.commandline.DefaultingCommandLineTest`. The failure occurs on the assertion that compares an expected group of options to the actual list of options returned by the `getOptions()` method of the `CommandLine` object.

The test created three options (`help`, `login`, and `targets`) and grouped them with a `GroupBuilder`. Then a `Parser` was used to parse the input string array `{"login", "rob", "--help", "target1", "target2"}` into a `CommandLine` object. The test asserts that the iterator `i` over the options in the `CommandLine` returns the whole group of options first (assertSame with `group`), but the failure shows that `i.next()` returns just the `--help` option instead of the whole group.

This suggests that the `getOptions()` method of the `CommandLine` object may be returning individual options instead of the group object where the options belong. To continue, I will retrieve the code of the `testGetOptions_Order` test to investigate its full implementation.

Based on the available information, provide the signatures of the most likely culprit methods for the bug. Your answer will be processed automatically, so make sure to only answer with the accurate signatures of all likely culprits (in `ClassName.MethodName(ArgType1, ArgType2, ...)` format), without commentary (one per line).
